title: Justice League Unlimited
description: Justice League Unlimited is an American animated television series that was produced by Warner Bros. Animation and aired on Cartoon Network. Featuring a wide array of superheroes from the DC Comics universe, and specifically based on the Justice League superhero team, it is a direct sequel to the previous Justice League animated series.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x1
episodes_data.description: After unsuccessfully attempting to recruit the Green Arrow to join the expanded League, he plays an important role with a team sent to manage a crisis in Asia.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x2
episodes_data.description: Batman and Wonder Woman find Superman immobilized in the Fortress of Solitude by a plant sent by the would-be conqueror Mongul.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x3
episodes_data.description: Morgaine Le Fey transforms Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, and Green Lantern into children after Mordred uses his magic to remove all adults from Earth and keep children on the Earth.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x4
episodes_data.description: Ares creates a war machine called the Annihilator to escalate a civil war in Kasnia. Hawk, Dove, and Wonder Woman try to stop his plans.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x5
episodes_data.description: When Circe changes Wonder Woman into a pig, Batman and Zatanna must find her and change her back.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x6
episodes_data.description: Supergirl, Green Arrow, and The Question investigate Supergirl's disturbing dreams. They discover that Cadmus created a clone of Supergirl named Galatea while she was recovering from her fight against Superman on Earth.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x7
episodes_data.description: The Justice League battle Mordru in the background, while the narrative follows Booster Gold as he attempts to close a walking black hole while he's supposed to be on "crowd control".

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x8
episodes_data.description: After blasting through the entire Green Lantern Corps, the android Amazo returns to Earth. Only the Justice League stands between him and his goal -- the now-reformed Lex Luthor.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x9
episodes_data.description: A team of too-good-to-be-true superheroes find out the truth about their origins and go on the rampage.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x10
episodes_data.description: Most of the League battles with powerful alien nanotechnology but, realize that the waves of self-replicating robots cannot be simply destroyed. The diminutive Atom shrinks himself to stop the robots from the inside.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x11
episodes_data.description: A trio of high school kids accidentally resurrect Solomon Grundy, reviving him more powerful than ever but with no memories of his past. Dr. Fate, Amazo, Aquaman, and Shayera assist League regulars stopping his rampage.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x12
episodes_data.description: While pursuing a time traveling thief, Batman, Wonder Woman and Green Lantern team up with a collection of DC Universe western heroes to battle the villain controlling him.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 1x13
episodes_data.description: The time traveling League team goes to the future to team up with that time's League to battle Chronos who rules.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x1
episodes_data.description: Black Canary convinces Green Arrow to help save her mentor, Wildcat, from his involvement in an underground, super-powered fight club known as MetaBrawl.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x2
episodes_data.description: Mister Miracle and Big Barda solicit Justice League assistance to free Oberon from Apokolips. J'onn refuses, but Flash decides to help out on his own.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x3
episodes_data.description: Superman battles Doomsday in the heart of a volcano. Doomsday is revealed to be a modified clone of Superman. Batman probes the Cadmus conspiracy to destroy the Justice League.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x4
episodes_data.description: Cadmus has recruited a team of supervillains named Task Force X (based on the comics' Suicide Squad) made up of Deadshot, Plastique, Captain Boomerang, and the Clock King. Their mission: steal the Annihilator armor from the Watchtower.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x5
episodes_data.description: To help her magic superhero friends, the God Hermes sends Wonder Woman on a mission to help free Hades from the clutches of Felix Faust.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x6
episodes_data.description: Seeking to avenge the death of her parents, the Huntress enlists the help of the Question in tracking down Steven Mandragora, a mobster in protective custody -- and being guarded by the Green Arrow and Black Canary.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x7
episodes_data.description: Captain Marvel joins the Justice League and his innocent presence inadvertently causes friction with Superman.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x8
episodes_data.description: Shayera, Vixen and Vigilante are lured into an ambush by Thanagarians seeking revenge.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x9
episodes_data.description: The Question, fearing disaster, decides to kill Lex Luthor to avert it.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x10
episodes_data.description: Lex Luthor executes his masterstroke to eliminate Project Cadmus and frame the Justice League.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x11
episodes_data.description: While the senior Leaguers struggle to respond to the mysterious main gun firing, Amanda Waller orders Galatea to lead a full attack on the Justice League.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x12
episodes_data.description: The Justice League charter members must battle the combined Lex Luthor/Brainiac menace alone.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 2x13
episodes_data.description: In the future, Terry McGinnis learns the truth about his birth.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x1
episodes_data.description: Lex Luthor is rescued from prison by a new villainous organization - the Legion of Doom!

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x2
episodes_data.description: Batman doesn't like the looks of Carter Hall, Shayara's new boyfriend, when he learns that Carter Hall has connections to Thanagar.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x3
episodes_data.description: Green Lantern leads Stargirl, S.T.R.I.P.E., and Supergirl to Skartaris, a fantastic world where they meet a new hero, The Warlord.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x4
episodes_data.description: Wonder Woman learns of a plot to steal the powers of the 3,000 year-old corpse of The Viking Prince.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x5
episodes_data.description: The Flash must handle an onslaught of super-villains during the opening of a museum in his honor.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x6
episodes_data.description: The League comes to the aid of Boston Brand, the ghost of a deceased circus acrobat, who needs their help in recovering the souls of members of a monastic order.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x7
episodes_data.description: Green Arrow must lead a team of non-powered superheroes against a berserk super-soldier attacking Metropolis.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x8
episodes_data.description: A mystic artifact causes Lex Luthor and the Flash to switch bodies.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x9
episodes_data.description: Roulette returns with a new version of Metabrawl...and plans to use the Justice League to boost her ratings.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x10
episodes_data.description: Supergirl is abducted to the 31st century to aid a futuristic group of super-heroes...and where it is destined she will never return.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x11
episodes_data.description: The Hawkman and Shadow Thief return.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x12
episodes_data.description: The Justice League take on their opposite numbers in the Legion of Doom in a final battle revealing the Legion's secret sponsor and the mystery behind their ultimate plans.

episodes_data.title: Justice League Unlimited 3x13
episodes_data.description: Faced with a common enemy, Lex Luthor and his criminals offer the League to join.
